title: 第五章 囤积
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

中午十二点整，两辆黑色面包车和一辆白色轿车鱼贯驶入冷链物流园的大门。

林越从轿车上下来的时候，手里提着两份盒饭和一瓶矿泉水。他把盒饭放在冷库门口的一摞托盘上，拧开矿泉水灌了两口，然后抬头看向正在从面包车上往下卸装备的五个人。

赵铭他们一上午没闲着。三栋冷库的内部结构已经摸清楚了，每栋两层，一层是大开间冷库，二层是配套的管理用房。大刘用一根铁棍撬开了所有锁着的门，老郑把每个房间的尺寸和门窗位置手绘成了草图，此刻正夹在腋下。小何的无人机已经在园区上空飞了四个来回，拍下了周边五百米范围内每一栋建筑的屋顶情况。阿青的急救物资清单已经发到了林越手机上，密密麻麻三页，字小得需要用手指放大才能看清。

“吃饭。”林越把盒饭往前推了一下，“十五分钟。吃完开始干活。”

没有人客气。五个人围过来，一人一盒，站着吃。冷库门口没有桌椅，他们就靠在墙上、坐在托盘上、蹲在台阶上，嘴里塞着饭，眼睛还时不时往园区四周扫一眼。这种警惕感不需要林越教——老郑和赵铭是部队带出来的，大刘和小何跟着他们养成了习惯，阿青学得最快，从昨晚到现在，他已经开始下意识地注意周边声响了。

“林哥。”赵铭三两下扒完了饭，把空饭盒往袋子里一塞，“下午先搞什么？”

“万邦仓储。”林越说，“建材区和五金区，我昨天踩过点。今天带大刘去，一辆面包车，能装多少装多少。水泥、钢筋捆扎丝、防尘口罩、发电机、铁丝网——按我清单上的优先级来。”

“铁丝网超市也有？”老郑问。

“有。园艺区的。两米高一卷的那种，镀锌铁丝网，本来是围花园用的。架在围墙上加高一米，就是防攀爬的利器。”林越把盒饭最后一口扒完，“质量不如军用的，但够用。我们先买光他库存，不够再去建材市场补。”

“五金区还有多少台发电机？”

“昨天我看到三台。两千瓦的，小型汽油发电机。够了。我们不是要供电给整个园区，只需要给冷库的照明、苏沐晴的实验室设备和通讯系统供电。三台轮换，绰绰有余。汽油的问题更大——发电机吃油，一晚上能烧掉半箱。我们得趁现在加油站还在正常运营，尽量多囤。”

“城北有六个加油站。”小何已经把笔记本电脑，流量太大，不好操作。四个在小路上，其中两个是自助加油站，二十四小时营业，没人管。用油桶去装，一次装两百升没问题。”

“油桶。”

“修车行有卖。”老郑接话，“二十升的标准汽油桶，北郊那条修车铺街上至少有四家店有现货。我昨天路过的时候数过。”

林越点头。老郑的观察力从来不需要别人操心。“你今天下午的任务——带小何去把油桶全部买光。然后去那两家自助加油站，能买多少买多少。不要省钱。汽油价格现在不重要，三天后就是液体黄金。”

老郑点了一下头，没有多余的话。

“阿青。”林越转向正在啃最后一口饭的年轻人，“你的清单我看了。三类东西你优先采购——止血带、抗生素、一次性缝合包。碘伏和纱布能买多少买多少。去城北的药店扫货，别在一家买太多，每家买一点，不要引起注意。”

“明白。”

“赵铭跟我去超市。大刘也是。下午两点出发，五点之前回来。”

一辆面包车从物流园大门驶出去的时候，林越坐在副驾驶上，把万邦仓储的库存清单在心里重新过了一遍。水泥十二袋，不够。至少需要四十袋。铁丝网园艺区只有四卷，不够。至少需要十五卷。防尘口罩三箱，这个暂时够了。发电机三台，能买多少台就买多少台——末世断电之后，谁有电谁就是文明的火种。

但所有这些物资加起来，他手里剩下的二十二万现金根本撑不住。卖房的钱要周一才能到账。信用卡额度还有五万。理财账户的十二万取出来需要两到三个工作日——刚好卡在末世爆发当天。这意味着在病毒爆发之前，他手里的流动资金只有三十万出头。

三十万，要撑起一个容纳百人的生存基地。

林越在心里算账的时候脸上没有任何表情。前世他见过太多因为物资短缺而死的人，但他也见过有人用极少的资源撑过了最艰难的时期。关键不在于有多少钱，而在于钱花在什么地方。铁丝网比吃的贵，但铁丝网能挡住丧尸，吃的不行。水泥比药品贵，但水泥能封住基地的漏洞，药品不能。他在心里给所有物资分了三档——第一档是防御物资，优先级最高，不计成本。第二档是可持续生存物资，包括种子、发电机、净水设备。第三档才是消耗品，食物、饮用水、药品。前两档花掉百分之八十的预算，第三档用剩下的百分之二十精打细算。

车子在仓储超市停车场停稳的时候，林越已经把所有账目算清楚了。

“走。”他推开车门。

下午的仓储超市比昨天热闹得多。周六，拖家带口的顾客推着购物车在货架间穿行，孩子们在零食区跑来跑去，促销员举着喇叭喊着特价信息。林越穿过人群的时候，一个推着满满一车打折卷纸的大妈差点撞到他，他侧身让开，脚步没有停。三天后，这个超市里的一半人会变成丧尸，另一半人会死在逃跑的路上。他不能救所有人，但他可以把这超市里最有用的东西提前搬走。

建材区没有人逛。

林越推了一辆平板推车，直接走到水泥货架前。十二袋，昨天看到的时候就是这个数量。他一把全部抱上推车。然后是钢筋捆扎丝，一整盘，二十公斤重，他一个人搬上去，推车晃了一下。防尘口罩三箱，垒在水泥袋上面。工业手套两盒。铁丝网四卷，每卷十五公斤，大刘一手一卷提起来放在推车上。

“发电机。”林越说。

三台小型汽油发电机还放在货架最底层，落满了灰。大刘弯腰一只手拎一台，另一台由林越推着往收银台走。路上经过户外用品区，林越扫了一眼——帐篷、睡袋、工兵铲、户外刀具。他停了两秒，在脑子里快速评估了一下。帐篷在末世初期有用，睡袋对住在冷库管理间里的人有用，工兵铲既是工具也是武器。他把推车停下来。

“大刘，再推一辆车。”

二十分钟后，两辆平板推车在收银台前排起了长队。一辆装满建材和发电机，另一辆装着十把工兵铲、八个睡袋、四顶帐篷、二十把多功能刀具和货架上所有的户外绳索。收银台的姑娘看了一眼第二辆推车，又看了一眼林越，眼神像是在看一个末日生存狂——她的判断完全正确。

“你们公司搞团建？”收银姑娘一边扫码一边问。

“对。”林越说，“深山老林，得带足了东西。”

这个理由完美无缺。周六下午来仓储超市大采购的团建组织者，比末日生存狂听起来可信一万倍。

刷卡的时候，两车物资一共花了两万四千块。林越看了一眼POS机上的余额，收起卡，和大刘一起把物资搬上停在门口的面包车。三台发电机塞进后备箱的时候，车厢的钢板明显往下一沉。

“林哥。”大刘拍了拍手上的灰，“就这些？”

“这只是第一批。”林越关上后备箱门，“五金区的水管和阀门还没买。还有工具——锤子、钉子、电钻、锯子。建造用的东西，一样不能少。但今天预算有限，先把最关键的拉回去。”

面包车返回物流园的时候，老郑和小何也刚回来。他们的面包车后面装了二十个二十升汽油桶，其中十五个已经灌满了汽油，剩下五个是备用的空桶。老郑从副驾驶上跳下来，脸上的表情难得松动了一点——那大概是满意。自助加油站的效率比他预想的还好。

“十五桶，三百升。”老郑说，“够三台发电机用一阵子了。”

“不够。”林越说，“明天继续。”

阿青是最后一个回来的。他背着一个大号登山包，里面装满了从城北六家不同药店扫来的物资。止血带二十条，碘伏三十瓶，纱布卷四十个，阿莫西林和头孢类抗生素各十盒，一次性缝合包八个，还有三瓶医用酒精和两盒一次性手套。他把包放在冷库地上，一样一样往外掏的时候，手指很稳，没有一件东西掉地上。林越看着他的手——赵铭说过，阿青的手特别稳。卫生员的手。

“今晚之前再列一份补充清单。”林越对他说，“今天买的是急救物资。下一批是慢性病用药——胰岛素、降压药、哮喘喷雾。这些东西末世之后没人生产，现在不囤，以后就是绝症。”

阿青点头。

傍晚六点，夕阳把物流园的围墙染成橘红色。林越站在冷库门口，看着堆在墙边的物资——十二袋水泥，三台发电机，四卷铁丝网，二十公斤钢筋捆扎丝，三箱防尘口罩，十五桶汽油，五个空油桶，医疗器械堆满了一个货架。这些东西在正常的商业社会里不值一提，但在三天后，它们将构成这个基地的第一道生存底线。

但还不够。

他拿出手机，拨通了王浩的电话。

第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

At exactly 12 noon, two black vans and a white car drove into the gate of the cold chain logistics park.

When Lin Yue got off the car, he was carrying two lunch boxes and a bottle of mineral water.He placed the lunch box on a stack of trays at the door of the cold storage, unscrewed the mineral water and took two sips, then looked up at the five people who were unloading equipment from the van.

Zhao Ming and the others were busy all morning.The internal structure of the three cold storage buildings has been clearly understood. Each building has two floors, with a large-bay cold storage on the first floor and supporting management rooms on the second floor.Liu used an iron bar to pry open all the locked doors. Lao Zheng made a hand-drawn sketch of the dimensions and door and window positions of each room, which he held under his arm at the moment.Xiao He's drone has flown over the park four times, taking pictures of the roofs of every building within a radius of 500 meters.Ah Qing's list of first-aid supplies has been sent to Lin Yue's mobile phone. It is densely packed into three pages, and the characters are so small that you need to use your finger to zoom in to see them clearly.

"Eat." Lin Yue pushed the lunch box forward, "Fifteen minutes. After eating, start working."

No one was polite.Five people gathered around, each with a box, and ate standing up.There were no tables and chairs at the entrance of the cold storage, so they leaned against the wall, sat on trays, or squatted on the steps, stuffing rice in their mouths and glancing around the park from time to time.This sense of vigilance does not need to be taught by Lin Yue - Lao Zheng and Zhao Ming were brought out by the army, and Da Liu and Xiao He formed a habit with them. Ah Qing learned the fastest. From last night to now, he has begun to subconsciously pay attention to the sounds around him.

"Brother Lin." Zhao Ming finished the meal in a few seconds and stuffed the empty lunch box into the bag, "What are you going to do first this afternoon?"

"Wanbang Warehouse." Lin Yue said, "I visited the building materials area and hardware area yesterday. Today I will take Da Liu there. A van can load as much as it can. Cement, steel bar binding wire, dust masks, generators, barbed wire - according to the priority on my list."

"Are there barbed wire supermarkets too?" Lao Zheng asked.

"Yes. It's from the gardening area. It's a two-meter-high roll of galvanized barbed wire. It was originally used to enclose the garden. Put it on the fence to increase the height by one meter, and it's a sharp tool to prevent climbing." Lin Yue finished the last bite of the lunch box. "The quality is not as good as the military one, but it is enough. Let's buy up his inventory first. If it is not enough, we will go to the building materials market to replenish it."

“How many more generators are there in the hardware area?”

"I saw three yesterday. Two-kilowatt, small gasoline generators. That's enough. We don't need to supply power to the entire park, we only need to power the lighting of the cold storage, Su Muqing's laboratory equipment, and communication systems. Three units are rotated, which is more than enough. The problem with gasoline is even bigger - the generators eat oil and can burn half a tank in one night. We have to stock up as much as possible while the gas station is still operating normally."

"There are six gas stations in the north of the city." Xiao He has already put down his laptop, which has too much traffic and is difficult to operate.Four are on small roads, two of which are self-service gas stations, open 24 hours a day and no one is in charge.Use oil drums to load them. It’s no problem to load two hundred liters at a time."

“Oil barrels."

“Car repair shops sell them."Lao Zheng answered, "Twenty-liter standard gasoline drums, at least four stores on the car repair shop street in the northern suburbs have them in stock.I counted them yesterday when I passed by."

Lin Yue nodded.Lao Zheng's observation skills never need others to worry about.“Your task this afternoon is to take Xiao He to buy all the oil barrels.Then go to the two self-service gas stations and buy as much as you can.Don't save money.Gasoline prices don't matter now, in three days they will be liquid gold."

Lao Zheng nodded without saying anything extra.

"Aqing.Lin Yue turned to the young man who was taking the last bite of rice, "I read your list."Three categories of items should be purchased first - tourniquets, antibiotics, and disposable suture kits.Buy as much iodine and gauze as you can.Go to the pharmacies in the north of the city to buy goods. Don't buy too much at one place. Buy a little at each store so as not to attract attention."

"clear."

"Zhao Ming went to the supermarket with me.So does Da Liu.Set off at two o'clock in the afternoon and be back before five o'clock."

When a van drove out from the gate of the logistics park, Lin Yue sat in the passenger seat and mentally reviewed the inventory list of Wanbang Warehousing.Twelve bags of cement are not enough.At least forty bags are required.There are only four rolls of wire fence for the gardening area, which is not enough.At least fifteen volumes are required.Three boxes of dust masks are enough for now.Three generators, buy as many as you can - after the power outage in the apocalypse, whoever has electricity will be the spark of civilization.

But when all these supplies were added up, the remaining 220,000 in cash in his hand simply couldn't sustain it.The money for selling the house won't arrive until Monday.The credit card limit is still 50,000.It takes two to three working days to withdraw the 120,000 yuan from the financial account—just on the day when the apocalypse breaks out.This means that before the virus outbreak, he had only a little over 300,000 in liquidity.

Three hundred thousand to support a survival base that can accommodate a hundred people.

Lin Yue had no expression on his face while he was settling accounts in his mind.In his previous life, he had seen too many people die due to lack of supplies, but he had also seen people survive the most difficult times with very few resources.The key is not how much money you have, but where you spend it.Barbed wire is more expensive than food, but barbed wire can keep away zombies, but food can't.Cement is more expensive than medicine, but cement can seal the loopholes in the base, medicine cannot.He divided all supplies into three categories in his mind - the first category was defense supplies, with the highest priority, regardless of cost.The second level is sustainable survival materials, including seeds, generators, and water purification equipment.The third level is consumables, food, drinking water, and medicine.The first two levels spend 80% of the budget, and the third level uses the remaining 20% carefully.

When the car stopped in the parking lot of the warehouse supermarket, Lin Yue had already calculated all the accounts.

"Let's go."He opened the car door.

The warehouse supermarket in the afternoon was much busier than yesterday.On Saturday, families with families pushed shopping carts through the aisles, children ran around in the snack area, and promoters shouted special offers with loudspeakers.When Lin Yue was walking through the crowd, an aunt pushing a cart full of discounted rolling papers almost bumped into him. He stepped aside without stopping.Three days later, half of the people in this supermarket will turn into zombies, and the other half will die on the way to escape.He can't save everyone, but he can move the most useful things in the supermarket in advance.

No one was shopping in the building materials area.

Lin Yue pushed a flatbed cart and walked directly to the cement shelves.Twelve bags, that's the amount when I saw it yesterday.He lifted them all into the cart.Then there was the steel bar binding wire, a whole tray, weighing 20 kilograms. He carried it up alone, and the cart shook a little.Three boxes of dust masks were piled on top of cement bags.Two boxes of industrial gloves.There were four rolls of barbed wire, each weighing 15 kilograms. Liu picked up the rolls one by one and placed them on the cart.

“Generator."Lin Yue said.

Three small gasoline generators were still on the bottom shelf, covered in dust.Da Liu bent down and carried one machine with one hand, while Lin Yue pushed the other toward the cashier.Passing by the outdoor supplies area on the road, Lin Yue glanced at it - tents, sleeping bags, engineer shovels, and outdoor knives.He paused for two seconds and made a quick assessment in his mind.Tents are useful in the early days of the apocalypse, sleeping bags are useful for people living in cold storage management rooms, and sapper shovels are both tools and weapons.He stopped the cart.

“Da Liu, push another car."

Twenty minutes later, two flatbed carts were lined up at the checkout counter.One was loaded with building materials and a generator, while the other contained ten sapper shovels, eight sleeping bags, four tents, twenty utility knives and all the outdoor rope on the shelves.The girl at the cashier glanced at the second cart and then at Lin Yue, her eyes like looking at a doomsday survivalist - her judgment was absolutely correct.

“Does your company do team building?"The cashier girl asked while scanning the code.

"Yes."Lin Yue said, "You have to bring enough things when you are in the deep mountains and old forests."

The reason is perfect.A team-building organizer who comes to a warehouse supermarket for a big purchase on Saturday afternoon sounds 10,000 times more credible than a doomsday survivalist.

When I swiped my card, the two trucks of supplies cost a total of 24,000 yuan.Lin Yue glanced at the balance on the POS machine, put away the card, and moved the supplies to the van parked at the door with Da Liu.When the three generators were stuffed into the trunk, the steel plate of the car sank obviously.

"Brother Lin."Da Liu patted the dust on his hands and said, "That's all?"

“This is just the first batch.Lin Yue closed the trunk door, "I haven't bought the water pipes and valves in the hardware section yet."And tools - hammers, nails, drills, saws.Nothing is missing for construction.But today’s budget is limited, so let’s pull back the most critical things first."

When the van returned to the logistics park, Lao Zheng and Xiao He had just returned.There were twenty twenty-liter gasoline barrels in the back of their van, fifteen of which were filled with gasoline, and the remaining five were empty barrels for spare use.Lao Zheng jumped out of the passenger seat, and the expression on his face relaxed a little - probably because of satisfaction.The self-service gas station was more efficient than he expected.

“Fifteen barrels, three hundred liters."Lao Zheng said, "It's enough for three generators to last for a while."

"Not enough.Lin Yue said, "Continue tomorrow.""

Ah Qing was the last one to come back.He was carrying a large hiking bag filled with supplies swept from six different pharmacies in the north of the city.Twenty tourniquets, thirty bottles of iodine, forty gauze rolls, ten boxes each of amoxicillin and cephalosporin antibiotics, eight disposable suture kits, three bottles of medical alcohol and two boxes of disposable gloves.He put the bag on the floor of the cold storage, and when he took it out one by one, his fingers were very steady and nothing fell to the ground.Lin Yue looked at his hands - Zhao Ming said that Ah Qing's hands were particularly stable.Hygienist's hands.

“Make another list before tonight.Lin Yue said to him, "What I bought today are first aid supplies."The next batch is chronic disease medications—insulin, blood pressure medications, asthma sprays.No one will produce these things after the apocalypse. If you don’t stock them now, they will become terminally ill in the future."

Ah Qing nodded.

At six o'clock in the evening, the setting sun dyed the walls of the logistics park orange.Lin Yue stood at the door of the cold storage and looked at the materials piled against the wall - twelve bags of cement, three generators, four rolls of barbed wire, 20 kilograms of steel bar binding wire, three boxes of dust masks, fifteen barrels of gasoline, five empty oil barrels, and a shelf full of medical equipment.These things are not worth mentioning in normal business society, but in three days, they will form the first bottom line of survival for this base.

But it's not enough.

He took out his cell phone and dialed Wang Hao's number.
